spans.s:
EXQUISITE (adj.):
I Excellent: अत्युत्तमः (मा,
 मं).
II Most delightful: अतिरम्यः (म्या, म्यं);
मनोहारिन् (f. णी): v. Delightful, charming.
III Extreme: q. v.: परमः (मा, मं).

EXQUISITELY: expr. by adj.: v. Also extreme-
-ly; well.

EXQUISITENESS:
I Lit.:
(1) अत्युत्तमता;
(2)
अतिरमणीयता; etc.
II Extremity: expr. by
परमः (मा, मं).
III Sharpness: तीव्रता।
